Visit OpenSearch Dashboards
After you create a data source, OpenSearch Service provides you with an OpenSearch Dashboards
link. You can use this to conﬁgure access control, deﬁne tables, install out-of-the-box integrations,
and query your data.
For more information, see the section called “Conﬁguring an S3 data source”.
